    "Customization options might feel limited for specific design workflows.",
    "Reporting features could be more robust for detailed analysis.",
    "Learning curve for advanced features or initial setup might require some effort."

  "overall_experience": "This designer found Pipedrive to be a highly effective tool for managing clients and tracking deals within their small design firm. The visual pipeline and intuitive interface made it easy to adopt and integrate into their workflow. While generally satisfied, they might have wished for more advanced customization or reporting capabilities to perfectly align with specific creative project needs, and customer support responsiveness could sometimes be a point of friction."
